label: q36-35b-llamacpp
model_path: Ollama's GGUF of qwen3.6:35b-a3b-mtp-q4_K_M (Q4_K_M, blob d372de8e)
note: Plain llama-server on the GGUF Ollama ships for this model (read from the Ollama store, so llama.cpp and Ollama run the same file; set QWEN36_35B_GGUF to use a copy elsewhere). -c 32768 -np 1 (the default -np auto means 4 slots and 4x the recurrent state); -b/-ub 2048, the 2048-token prefill chunks the MLX engines and Kapitsa use (MoE prefill reads every expert once per ubatch); -lm none so the weights count in phys_footprint like everyone else's (no speed change on unified memory); the official Qwen3.6 chat template (Ollama's GGUFs carry none, and llama.cpp would fall back to chatml); --min-p 0 (llama.cpp's default is 0.05); prompt cache and context checkpoints at their defaults; GGML_METAL_RESIDENCY_KEEP_ALIVE_S keeps the weights wired through the quiet-GPU wait.
